Maya R: Quick sync — planning a webinar next week focused on prompt templates. Want to tie free credits -> onboarding nudges and capture benchmark narratives. Need landing post, inbound routing, and short how-to copy. Who can own what?

Sam K: Love it. Audience: devs + platform teams. Experiment idea: Variant A = 500 free credits + promptpack, Variant B = 250 credits + quickstart lab. Track activation within 7 days.

Maya R: Can we define "activated" as first 3 API calls + at least one embedding request or 5k tokens used? Need a deterministic event.

Leo D: Yep. I'll add an event `promptpack_activated` and a cohort tag `webinar_seed_04`. ETA today.

Tia: Copy ideas (short):
- Post headline: "Build with open LLMs — free credits + curated prompt templates"
- CTA: "Claim credits & join the hands-on webinar"
- Followup doc snippet for quickstart and example prompt.

Sam K: Also want a 1-paragraph benchmark narrative for the launch post: show cost/latency improvements using our promptpack vs naive prompt. @Leo can you pull numbers?

Leo D: On it — I'll pull batching + KV cache perf and output a 3-line summary + CSV by EOD. Runtime batching showed ~22% token cost reduction for the sample workload.

Maya R: Inbound routing plan: high-intent (sign up + webinar scheduled) => create SDR task and priority support tag. Lower intent => automated email drip with prompt templates and tips.

Tia: Proposed email drip cadence: Day 0 welcome + credit usage tips, Day 2 prompt template spotlight, Day 5 invite to office hours. Use UTMs: `?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=seed_apr`.

Sam K: For the A/B experiment we need a feature flag at signup and experiment tracking. I'll own the flag + metrics dashboard (activation, retention, credit burn).

Maya R: Next steps recap: Leo = event + bench numbers, Tia = draft copy + email sequence by EOD, Sam = feature flag + routing rules, I'll schedule 30m tomorrow 10:30 to finalize. :calendar:

GrowthBot: Reminder: webinar registration seats 0/500 (placeholder until registration opens).

Tia: Uploaded draft copies to drive: https://drive.redwood/marketing/webinar-seed-drafts (will replace with final link).
